title: TACP v0.3.0 Mission and Recovery Bundles
description: Structural validation for specs/tacp-v0.3.md. Accepts standalone closed missions or bounded human-reviewed recovery bundles. Does not prove runtime authority, evidence truth, or cross-document uniqueness.
$comment: Use strict JSON parsing (reject duplicate members and non-finite numbers) and date-time format assertion. Separate v0.3 semantic validation is REQUIRED for all inherited v0.2 semantics, record IDs and references, chronological order and fractional-precision expiry comparisons, source integrity, candidate equality and operation continuity, new authorization identity, issue carryover and resolution, recovery usage and budgets, evidence-reference uniqueness/freshness, human identity binding, start windows, and successor reservation identity. Runtime enforcement additionally requires authenticated human authority, trusted evidence, revocation checks, persistent fences, and atomic cross-document claim/operation deduplication. Existing scripts/validate.py does not yet implement v0.3. Only local schema references are used.

reference.description: Opaque record or deployment reference. Resolution, type, order, and authenticity require separate validation.

utc_timestamp.$comment: Enable date-time format assertion. The pattern enforces UTC syntax; format checking must reject invalid calendar dates. Relative time ordering is semantic validation.

review_check.$comment: Empty evidence_refs is allowed only when finding explicitly remains unverified. This natural-language requirement needs semantic review.

dispatch_check.title: TACP dispatch_check record
dispatch_check.$comment: A passing record never authorizes dispatch by itself. Runtime revalidation and atomic prerequisite enforcement remain mandatory.
